name: view_duel_salts_survive_a_restart
description: A networked game killed or closed mid-duel takes its seat back when it starts again (AGENTS.md, Identity's note in user://net.cfg), and its corked bottles their salts (contract-m7.md §3), on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker. Game.salt_match stands in for the MatchClient's match id. In window 9 (reached by playing wave 8) a cork's salt is filed in user://duel/77-1.cfg as soon as its CORK goes out; a second CORK goes out and the game dies before its turn (its memory of the duel gone), and the CORK stands the bottle meanwhile. Started again (Game attached to the match again, as a rejoin's RESYNC does), the game takes both salts back: the bottle whose EV_CORK it saw, and the one whose CORK ran while it was down (the waiting cork whose window, pack and salt give the bottle's commitment). Both uncork with Space and the simulation takes both reveals; when the duel is decided the file goes, and an offline match files nothing.

steps.msg: in match 77 a cork's salt is filed on this machine (user://duel/77-1.cfg)
key 2 corks, and the game is killed before its turn: no memory of the duel is left

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 2 and not Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and not Game.my_bottles()[1]['known']
steps.msg: its CORK stood the bottle while no game held either salt

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 2 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[1]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == offer[0] and Game.my_bottles()[1]['pack'] == offer[1] and Game.corks_left() == 0 and Game._corks_waiting.is_empty()
steps.msg: started again in match 77 (the world loaded as a rejoin's RESYNC loads it), the game takes both salts back from the file: the bottle whose EV_CORK it saw, and the one that stood while it was down

steps.assert: Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['uncorked'] and Game.bottles_of(1)[1]['uncorked'] and not Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['fizzled'] and not Game.bottles_of(1)[1]['fizzled']
steps.msg: Space uncorks both, and the simulation takes both reveals; nothing fizzles
each UNCORK reveals the salt its CORK committed to
the duel decided, its salts' file goes
